relationships.subject: Tiam1
relationships.evidence_quote: Tiam1 is required for chronic pain–induced spinogenesis in adult mice

key_findings: Tiam1 is activated in ACC in SNI and CFA chronic pain and is required for pain-induced depressive-like behavior but not pain hypersensitivity.
Tiam1 drives ACC spine remodeling, F/G-actin shift and synaptic NMDAR increase; ketamine and NSC23766 reverse these.
